editor.guidanceHelp: Enter approved facts and remedies. The agent rephrases them naturally while preserving dates, conditions and benefits; this is not a verbatim script.
editor.dateHelp: Notice dates control visibility to the agent. The event may happen later. Leave notice dates empty to apply immediately. Times use your browser timezone.
editor.invalidForm: Check guidance, CIDRs, severity and notice date order.
editor.handoffHelp: When allowed, verified requests for incident handling go to Admin; general policy questions do not create tickets.
editor.legacyHelp: Legacy content has been merged. Review duplicate or conflicting statements before saving.

title: Operational incidents
description: Manage structured notices that agents may use when handling affected proxy networks.
help: Use one CIDR per line. Tool results always take precedence over an incident notice.
emptyDescription: Add a structured notice to guide agents during a known incident.
formDescription: These fields become structured context; agents cannot edit them during a customer conversation.
